thread:
amy: Hey folks — we need to lock the next cross‑func sync for the Q2 priority triage and RFC reviews. Can people take ownership of the agenda?

devin: I can draft the agenda. Suggest sections: 1) urgent regressions, 2) RFC reviews (runtime + routing), 3) capacity asks, 4) open decisions.

maria: 👍 would be great if we can surface decision logs up front. Product wants to finalize two prioritization items before Friday.

josh: Timewise I'm blocked mornings PST next week. Afternoon works. Also: can we carve 15m for engineering tradeoffs on the routing fallback?

amy: Noted @josh. Devin — can you add a 15m slot for routing? Maria — which two items need decisions?

maria: The two items are: 1) whether we push Dedicated rollout to late-May or keep current June plan, 2) acceptance criteria for the new batcher config. Both need clear owners.

devin: Added routing slot. For owners: @oliver for Dedicated rollout proposal, @josh for batcher config acceptance criteria. I can own meeting facilitation + notes.

oliver: I can prep a short decision doc (1 page) on rollout risk and phasing. Will attach to the thread by EOD Thursday.

josh: Will put together acceptance test checklist and a short perf regression table. ETA Thursday morning.

amy: Cool. Scheduling: what's the best time? I ran a quick poll — mornings CET / afternoons PST seemed best. Options: Tue 11:00am CET (2:00am PT - no), Tue 4:00pm CET (7:00am PT), Wed 9:00am CET (12:00am PT) — none ideal.

devin: Oof. How about Wed 5:00pm CET (8:00am PT)? Not great for some, but middle ground.

maria: I can do Wed 5pm CET. @sre-bot any conflicts with infra maintenance?

sre-bot: infra-maintenance: scheduled 2026-05-13 07:00-09:00 UTC (affects EU-central-1). No conflict with proposed Wed 17:00 CET slot.

amy: OK let's tentatively take Wed 17:00 CET / 08:00 PT. Devin please create calendar invite and set agenda owners.

devin: Will do. I'll include links to: 1) oliver's decision doc (when available), 2) josh's test checklist, 3) RFC drafts for runtime and routing. Also adding a decision-log section in the doc: we will record final decision + owner + follow-up ticket.

oliver: Quick Q — do we want the meeting recorded and posted to the decision log?

amy: Yes please. Recording + short bullet notes in the decision log. If someone can't attend, they should leave comments on the agenda doc ahead of time.

maria: One more: can we cap total meeting length to 60 minutes? If items spill, spin up a follow-up smaller triage with stakeholders.

devin: Agreed, 60m cap. I'll add timeboxes per section.

amy: Thanks everyone. Action items: devin create invite + doc; oliver prep decision doc (EOD Thu); josh prep checklist (Thu AM); everyone else leave comments on agenda by Wed 12:00 CET.

josh: noted, will do.

maria: thanks — looking forward to getting these decisions locked. :thumbsup:

devin: Invite sent. Calendar shows Wed 2026-05-13 17:00 CET / 08:00 PT, 60m. Attached agenda link.

amy: Perfect — closing thread.
